key_insight: Factorial testing identified HVOF settings that produced acceptable hardness, porosity, and oxide attributes in Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coatings on Ti6Al4V.
engineering_relevance: The reported settings offer a starting point for coating process development: 150 mm standoff, 25 g/min powder feed, 475 NLPM hydrogen, and 205 NLPM oxygen.
method: Conducted a two-level full factorial DOE with 24 experimental runs.
Measured coating properties and used ANOVA to quantify spray-parameter contributions.
Used Pareto charts to assess parameter interaction effects.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports coating-property measurements across 24 runs but provides no numerical response values or statistical significance results.
watch_item: Validate the reported settings on the intended equipment; the abstract does not establish transferability or quantify acceptable property thresholds.
paper_title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
